title: LimitX
description: This plugin limits items within the inventory and allows you to create custom item cooldowns.
body:
# 🛡️ LimitX

**LimitX** is a straightforward utility for server owners who want to prevent players from stacking powerful or abusable mechanics. From items and enchantments to potions and explosives, LimitX enforces hard limits instantly — no warnings, no bypasses.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Aggressive Item Limits**  
  Set a maximum amount for any item. Excess items are deleted the moment they enter a player’s inventory and play an item break sound.

* **Enchantment Limiter**  
  Restrict or disable specific enchantments and enforce custom maximum levels. Limits are checked whenever items are held, moved, or equipped.

* **Robust Anti-Bypass**  
  Actively scans the cursor item and off-hand to block common dupe and bypass methods used against other limiters.

* **Potion Nerfs**  
  Block specific potion effects or tiers from being used or thrown.

* **Combat Toggles**  
  Enable or disable End Crystals, Respawn Anchors, and Bed Bombing directly from the GUI.

* **Vanilla Cooldowns**  
  Apply custom cooldowns to items using the native vanilla cooldown overlay.

* **Fully In-Game Management**  
  Configure everything through `/limitx` using an in-game input system — no config editing required (except for bypass permissions).

---

## 🛠️ Requirements

| Requirement | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **ProtocolLib** | **Required** |
| **Platform** | Paper 1.21/1.21.1|

---

## 📝 Permissions

* `limitx.admin` — Required to open the menu and manage limits

> Operators do **not** bypass limits by default.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This plugin is innefective if admin abuse occurs on the server.
